verses.en: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favour rather than silver and gold.
verses.pt: Mais digno de ser escolhido é o bom nome do que as muitas riquezas; e o favor é melhor do que a prata e o ouro.
verses.en_web: A good name is more desirable than great riches, and loving favor is better than silver and gold.
verses.en_bbe: A good name is more to be desired than great wealth, and to be respected is better than silver and gold.

verses.en: The rich and poor meet together: the LORD is the maker of them all.
verses.pt: O rico e o pobre se encontram; quem os faz a ambos é o Senhor.
verses.en_web: The rich and the poor have this in common: Yahweh is the maker of them all.
verses.en_bbe: The man of wealth and the poor man come face to face: the Lord is the maker of them all.

verses.en: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself: but the simple pass on, and are punished.
verses.pt: O prudente vê o perigo e esconde-se; mas os simples passam adiante e sofrem a pena.
verses.en_web: A prudent man sees danger, and hides himself; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.
verses.en_bbe: The sharp man sees the evil and takes cover: the simple go straight on and get into trouble.

verses.en: By humility and the fear of the LORD are riches, and honour, and life.
verses.pt: O galardão da humildade e do temor do Senhor é riquezas, e honra e vida.
verses.en_web: The result of humility and the fear of Yahweh is wealth, honor, and life.
verses.en_bbe: The reward of a gentle spirit and the fear of the Lord is wealth and honour and life.

verses.en: Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward: he that doth keep his soul shall be far from them.
verses.pt: Espinhos e laços há no caminho do perverso; o que guarda a sua alma retira-se para longe deles.
verses.en_web: Thorns and snares are in the path of the wicked: whoever guards his soul stays from them.
verses.en_bbe: Thorns and nets are in the way of the twisted: he who keeps watch over his soul will be far from them.

verses.en: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
verses.pt: Instrui o menino no caminho em que deve andar, e até quando envelhecer não se desviará dele.
verses.en_web: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.
verses.en_bbe: If a child is trained up in the right way, even when he is old he will not be turned away from it.

verses.en: The rich ruleth over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.
verses.pt: O rico domina sobre os pobres; e o que toma emprestado é servo do que empresta.
verses.en_web: The rich rule over the poor. The borrower is servant to the lender.
verses.en_bbe: The man of wealth has rule over the poor, and he who gets into debt is a servant to his creditor.

verses.en: He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity: and the rod of his anger shall fail.
verses.pt: O que semear a perversidade segará males; e a vara da sua indignação falhará.
verses.en_web: He who sows wickedness reaps trouble, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.
verses.en_bbe: By planting the seed of evil a man will get in the grain of sorrow, and the rod of his wrath will be broken.

verses.en: He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed; for he giveth of his bread to the poor.
verses.pt: Quem vê com olhos bondosos será abençoado; porque dá do seu pão ao pobre.
verses.en_web: He who has a generous eye will be blessed; for he shares his food with the poor.
verses.en_bbe: He who is kind will have a blessing, for he gives of his bread to the poor.

verses.en: Cast out the scorner, and contention shall go out; yea, strife and reproach shall cease.
verses.pt: Lança fora ao escarnecedor, e a contenda se irá; cessarao a rixa e a injúria.
verses.en_web: Drive out the mocker, and strife will go out; yes, quarrels and insults will stop.
verses.en_bbe: Send away the man of pride, and argument will go out; truly fighting and shame will come to an end.

verses.en: He that loveth pureness of heart, for the grace of his lips the king shall be his friend.
verses.pt: O que ama a pureza do coração, e que tem graça nos seus lábios, terá por seu amigo o rei.
verses.en_web: He who loves purity of heart and speaks gracefully is the king’s friend.
verses.en_bbe: He whose heart is clean is dear to the Lord; for the grace of his lips the king will be his friend.

verses.en: The eyes of the LORD preserve knowledge, and he overthroweth the words of the transgressor.
verses.pt: Os olhos do Senhor preservam o que tem conhecimento; mas ele transtorna as palavras do prevaricador.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s eyes watch over knowledge; but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful.
verses.en_bbe: The eyes of the Lord keep knowledge, but by him the acts of the false man will be overturned.

verses.en: The slothful man saith, There is a lion without, I shall be slain in the streets.
verses.pt: Diz o preguiçoso: um leão está lá fora; serei morto no meio das ruas.
verses.en_web: The sluggard says, “There is a lion outside! I will be killed in the streets!”
verses.en_bbe: The hater of work says, There is a lion outside: I will be put to death in the streets.

verses.en: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit: he that is abhorred of the LORD shall fall therein.
verses.pt: Cova profunda é a boca da adúltera; aquele contra quem o Senhor está irado cairá nela.
verses.en_web: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit. He who is under Yahweh’s wrath will fall into it.
verses.en_bbe: The mouth of strange women is a deep hole: he with whom the Lord is angry will go down into it.

verses.en: Foolishness is bound in the heart of a child; but the rod of correction shall drive it far from him.
verses.pt: A estultícia está ligada ao coração do menino; mas a vara da correção a afugentará dele.
verses.en_web: Folly is bound up in the heart of a child: the rod of discipline drives it far from him.
verses.en_bbe: Foolish ways are deep-seated in the heart of a child, but the rod of punishment will send them far from him.

verses.en: He that oppresseth the poor to increase his riches, and he that giveth to the rich, shall surely come to want.
verses.pt: O que para aumentar o seu lucro oprime o pobre, e dá ao rico, certamente chegará à: penuria.
verses.en_web: Whoever oppresses the poor for his own increase and whoever gives to the rich, both come to poverty.
verses.en_bbe: He who is cruel to the poor for the purpose of increasing his profit, and he who gives to the man of wealth, will only come to be in need.

verses.en: Bow down thine ear, and hear the words of the wise, and apply thine heart unto my knowledge.
verses.pt: Inclina o teu ouvido e ouve as palavras dos sábios, e aplica o teu coração ao meu conhecimento.
verses.en_web: Turn your ear, and listen to the words of the wise. Apply your heart to my teaching.
verses.en_bbe: Let your ear be bent down for hearing my words, and let your heart give thought to knowledge.

verses.en: For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee; they shall withal be fitted in thy lips.
verses.pt: Porque será coisa suave, se os guardares no teu peito, se estiverem todos eles prontos nos teus lábios.
verses.en_web: For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you, if all of them are ready on your lips.
verses.en_bbe: For it is a delight to keep them in your heart, to have them ready on your lips.

verses.en: That thy trust may be in the LORD, I have made known to thee this day, even to thee.
verses.pt: Para que a tua confiança esteja no senhor, a ti tos fiz saber hoje, sim, a ti mesmo.
verses.en_web: I teach you today, even you, So that your trust may be in Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: So that your faith may be in the Lord, I have made them clear to you this day, even to you.

verses.en: Have not I written to thee excellent things in counsels and knowledge,
verses.pt: Porventura não te escrevi excelentes coisas acerca dos conselhos e do conhecimento,
verses.en_web: Haven’t I written to you thirty excellent things of counsel and knowledge,
verses.en_bbe: Have I not put in writing for you thirty sayings, with wise suggestions and knowledge,

verses.en: That I might make thee know the certainty of the words of truth; that thou mightest answer the words of truth to them that send unto thee?
verses.pt: para te fazer saber a certeza das palavras de verdade, para que possas responder com palavras de verdade aos que te enviarem?
verses.en_web: To teach you truth, reliable words, to give sound answers to the ones who sent you?
verses.en_bbe: To make you see how certain are true words, so that you may give a true answer to those who put questions to you?

verses.en: Rob not the poor, because he is poor: neither oppress the afflicted in the gate:
verses.pt: Não roubes ao pobre, porque é pobre; nem oprimas ao aflito na porta;
verses.en_web: Don’t exploit the poor, because he is poor; and don’t crush the needy in court;
verses.en_bbe: Do not take away the property of the poor man because he is poor, or be cruel to the crushed ones when they come before the judge:

verses.en: For the LORD will plead their cause, and spoil the soul of those that spoiled them.
verses.pt: porque o Senhor defenderá a sua causa em juízo, e aos que os roubam lhes tirará a vida.
verses.en_web: for Yahweh will plead their case, and plunder the life of those who plunder them.
verses.en_bbe: For the Lord will give support to their cause, and take the life of those who take their goods.

verses.en: Make no friendship with an angry man; and with a furious man thou shalt not go:
verses.pt: Não faças amizade com o iracundo; nem andes com o homem colérico;
verses.en_web: Don’t befriend a hot-tempered man, and don’t associate with one who harbors anger:
verses.en_bbe: Do not be friends with a man who is given to wrath; do not go in the company of an angry man:

verses.en: Lest thou learn his ways, and get a snare to thy soul.
verses.pt: para que não aprendas as suas veredas, e tomes um laço para a tua alma.
verses.en_web: lest you learn his ways, and ensnare your soul.
verses.en_bbe: For fear of learning his ways and making a net ready for your soul.

verses.en: Be not thou one of them that strike hands, or of them that are sureties for debts.
verses.pt: Não estejas entre os que se comprometem, que ficam por fiadores de dívidas.
verses.en_web: Don’t you be one of those who strike hands, of those who are collateral for debts.
verses.en_bbe: Be not one of those who give their hands in an agreement, or of those who make themselves responsible for debts:

verses.en: If thou hast nothing to pay, why should he take away thy bed from under thee?
verses.pt: Se não tens com que pagar, por que tirariam a tua cama de debaixo de ti?
verses.en_web: If you don’t have means to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you?
verses.en_bbe: If you have nothing with which to make payment, he will take away your bed from under you.

verses.en: Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set.
verses.pt: Não removas os limites antigos que teus pais fixaram.
verses.en_web: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone, which your fathers have set up.
verses.en_bbe: Let not the old landmark be moved which your fathers have put in place.

verses.en: Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men.
verses.pt: Vês um homem hábil na sua obrar? esse perante reis assistirá; e não assistirá perante homens obscuros.
verses.en_web: Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve kings. He won’t serve obscure men.
verses.en_bbe: Have you seen a man who is expert in his business? he will take his place before kings; his place will not be among low persons.
